name: lotus pose breathing
description: A seated cross-legged breathing practice that calms the mind and lengthens the spine while the hips stay open.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and each foot resting on the opposite thigh if comfortable.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Inhale slowly through your nose and fill your belly and chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and breathe steadily for 1-2 minutes.
